eventName: 6th Annual One Lakh Palm Seeds Plantation Festival ? 11th Phase Plantation Drive
eventDescription:
The special guests, the Executive Officer of Vallakottai Murugan Temple and the Forest Department Officer from Kundrathur, jointly delivered informative sessions to the students of Triveni Academy.
They explained the impacts of climate change, the importance of environmental conservation, and the responsibility of every individual in protecting nature.
Along with planting palm seeds, the students also gained valuable awareness about loving nature and protecting the environment.
